sinks.label: Stranded new-build gas capital
sinks.definition: Unrecovered capital on new-build gas vintages that hit the Card F' trigger (CF<15% for 2 consecutive years before book-life). When the trigger fires the vintage locks recovered_revenue_per_kw and the remainder of the $/kW book value is charged as stranded.

framing_copy: Every dollar to the right of this diagram is capital that ratepayers put into new-build gas which the plant will never earn back. The trigger is Card F': two consecutive years of capacity factor below 15%, which locks recovery at the revenue earned to that date.

meta.stranding_definition: Absolute stranded capex per SPEC Card K'/F'. Not comparative to P3.
meta.sizing_basis: New-gas capacity on each vintage is worst-hour sized (SPEC §24.5 99.97th percentile residual gap), not ELCC. Stranded capex then follows from the locked revenue recovery at Card F' trigger.
meta.note: Flow widths proportional to absolute stranded capex ($USD). Dropped old Card K comparative framing in favor of Card K' absolute.
